consequences_for_the_build: Step 3: the row host has 0px of room below the chips in three of four modes, so the new shadow (5px below) would be fully clipped. Give the host padding-bottom in every mode; the carousel viewport needs the same room or a negative margin trick.

Step 5: the white ring has been invisible on chips since the row got overflow:hidden (2026-09-01). The bottom bar (inset, never clipped) becomes the chip's visible focus cue. Any bottom room added for the shadow would let the clipped ring's bottom edge peek out as a white underline, so the ring rule must stop targeting the chips rather than be merged with the bar.
The gap the maintainer asked for is real and is 0 today in their mode, not 12.
